learning_outcomes.text: Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction, self-inductance, mutual inductance.
Electromagnetic waves, interaction of radiation with matter. Light.
Wave optics, interference. Special theory of relativity.
Particle nature of radiation. Photoelectric effect. Black-body radiation, the Compton effect.
Wave-particle nature of matter. De Broglie waves. The Heisenberg uncertainty principle.
Models of hydrogen atom, quantum numbers, electron spin.
Introduction into quantum mechanics - Schrodinger equation.
Particle in a box. Harmonic oscillator. Periodic system of elements.
Radioactivity, activity, disintegration law, half-life, sources of nuclear energy, measurements.
